properties.description: Search-before-you-add fires from the TOOL and forces a choice, and the check cannot quietly stop working. SIX CASES in crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/search_first_fires_at_the_tool.rs. THE DEFECT CASE: two requirements stating one idea in different words — the second is REFUSED, and the refusal NAMES the match and BOTH routes, so it is a choice rather than a wall. THE ROLLBACK CASE is what makes the design sound: the node must be written before it can be searched (it needs to rank for its own text to give an in-query baseline), so a refusal that left it behind would create the very duplicate it refused — asserted by reading the node back and requiring null. BOTH DELIBERATE ROUTES are tested because the refusal recommends them: SHARPEN (call with the existing id — a revision, never refused, and its neighbour is seeded so the guard is the only reason it passes) and CREATE ANYWAY (`distinct_from` naming what was read and rejected). THE COUNTERWEIGHT decides whether this is usable at all: an unrelated requirement is created with no friction and no advisory — a check that refused often would be routed around, and a rule people route around is worse than no rule. CROSS-TYPE: a Capability restating a Requirement is caught, the pair most worth catching because a capability backed out of a requirement's own words is unmotivated_capability waiting to happen.
properties.findings: MUTATION-CHECKED THREE WAYS, each verified applied before running rather than assumed: disabling the refusal fails 3 cases; removing the rollback fails the rollback case alone; ignoring `distinct_from` fails both deliberate routes. ⚠️ A FOURTH MUTATION EXPOSED A VACUOUS TEST OF MY OWN and is why the neighbour seeding exists: the first revision test passed whether or not the guard was there, because a revision with no near neighbour has nothing to report either way — the same vacuous-branch failure ver:the-server-says-when-it-is-stale was written about, reproduced here and caught by mutating rather than by reading.
properties.name: Search-before-you-add fires from the tool and forces a choice
